comments.author: @KAMU13
comments.text:
One of the posters nailed it: It's the QUALITY of food that sucks! And add the crappy chemicals in the food, which you will never see in other countries. 

I have been to 47 countries to date; the worst food quality and the most overpriced ones are in our country. You eat fish or chicken in Spain, Croatia, Morocco, China, India, Korea, Japan, Singapore, France, Italy, Greece, or Serbia... and then compare the same in the USA, you will know what I am talking about. 
And the prices, when you compare the quality, are often 3-4 times higher in the USA. 

And then comes the tipping! I am sick and tired of it, and I am sure many are. Yes, you can argue your hearts out; that's our culture. No, it's not! It was created by the business owners who refuse to pay better wages and are sucking up our wages. 

And now the worst part: adding a 20% surcharge on the bill for bringing 4 people to eat. So if you are bringing your family to dinner/ lunch, you HAVE TO PAY 20% extra, and this is not the tip! So why would anyone go there? I have stopped! 

So here's my take: I would rather make my own meal and breakfast, which is a hundred times better in quality and saves me hundreds of dollars per month. I only go to restaurants abroad for peace of mind with quality and price, and not paying insane surcharges.
